purpose: Reviewed corrections to upstream border and place names, applied by yarn data:refresh:historical before publishing, so the combined payloads and the split files both carry them. Each border entry matches exactly one source record per listed year by its exact source values; each place entry matches exactly one source place. Only mis-decoded text and typos confirmed against the cited source (and upstream's own spelling in other years) are corrected; variant spellings are left alone. See docs/HISTORICAL_DATA.md "Reviewed name overrides".
